label: Coverage-first
description: Prioritize complete gene accounting, dominant biological themes, and clear handling of orphans/evidence-sparse genes.
intent: Use this when the main goal is to account for every relevant gene or finding before moving to narrower mechanistic claims.

sections.heading: Question and Scope
sections.guidance: State the analysis question, cohort or context, and what evidence sources are currently in scope.

sections.heading: Gene-by-Gene Coverage
sections.guidance: Walk through the major genes or findings one by one, noting what evidence exists for each and what remains thin.

sections.heading: Dominant Biological Themes
sections.guidance: Summarize the strongest recurring pathways, programs, or disease themes that appear across the evidence.

sections.heading: Orphans and Sparse Evidence
sections.guidance: Call out genes or observations that do not yet fit the main themes or lack enough support for interpretation.

sections.heading: Confidence and Gaps
sections.guidance: Explain which parts of the interpretation are well supported versus provisional, and what evidence is still missing.

sections.heading: Bottom Line
sections.guidance: End with a concise coverage-oriented synthesis that reflects both what is supported and what remains unresolved.
